message: No detected input validation: The download function only checks whether files already exist on disk; there is no validation of file structure, schema, dtype, or value ranges after download.

No detected untrusted source handling: Files are fetched via urlretrieve from a GitHub raw URL with no checksum verification, signature check, or pinned commit/revision, so integrity of downloaded data is never confirmed.
No detected label flipping detection: The code contains no checks for label-flipping anomalies, unexpected label values, or label distribution comparisons; labels are used as-is from CSV files.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or suspicious-input filtering applied to the downloaded training data before use.

No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained models like 'bert-base-uncased' and 'distilbert-base-uncased' are referenced by name with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity before loading.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any backdoor/trigger defense present in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are present anywhere in the code.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, shape checks, schema enforcement, or malformed-input rejection is visible anywhere on the inference data-flow path.

No detected output bounds checks: The evaluation code applies a 0.5 threshold to discretize labels but there are no NaN guards, probability range assertions, or sanity bounds applied to raw model outputs before use.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although BERT/DistilBERT transformer models are used, the pipeline is a classification/matching task with no chat or generative text output, and no prompt-injection filtering or output content moderation is implemented.
